title: 第一章：今天开始营业 · 第二节：集市，不愿透露姓名的少女
description: 进城采购 · 识破灯油说明 · 初遇莉瑟 · 提灯的异常反应
source: 原创奇幻剧情与四道分段听力理解题，非考试原文。
audioLabel: 离线英文配音 · 莉瑟：MiniMax 温暖少女 · 其他角色：固定角色配音

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Beyond the town gate, Lu Chuan hears the market calls. Flour comes first on his list, followed by eggs.
lines.translation: 穿过镇门，陆川听见叫卖声。清单上的第一项是面粉，第二项是鸡蛋。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Essentials first. Aelia's advice comes before any pretty sign.
lines.translation: 先买必需品。艾莉娅的话，得记在漂亮招牌前面。

lines.speaker: 摊主
lines.text: Flour on the left, eggs in the basket. If you run a shop, I can deliver them to your door.
lines.translation: 面粉在左边，鸡蛋在篮子里。开店的话，我可以帮你送到门口。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: The waystation beyond the stone bridge is opening today. One small bag of flour and twelve eggs, please.
lines.translation: 石桥外的驿站，今天准备开门。先给我一小袋面粉和十二个鸡蛋。

lines.speaker: 摊主
lines.text: That waystation? Last night I thought it would collapse. Have you repaired the roof?
lines.translation: 那间驿站？昨晚我还以为它要塌了。你们把屋顶修好了？

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: We have. Now it is the kitchen's turn. We cannot serve our guests a roof.
lines.translation: 修好了。现在轮到厨房，不能让客人只吃屋顶。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: At the next stall, a silver-haired girl stops beside the lamp oil. Her lantern is still lit, but its light is unsteady.
lines.translation: 隔壁灯油摊前，一位银发少女停下了脚步。她手中的提灯没有熄灭，却忽明忽暗。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: I need oil that keeps magical light steady. Is this bottle really suitable for a rune lantern?
lines.translation: 我要的是稳定魔力的灯油。这个瓶子，真的能用于符文提灯吗？

lines.speaker: 摊主
lines.text: Certainly. There is silver around the neck, and it costs more than ordinary oil.
lines.translation: 当然。瓶口有银线，价钱也比普通灯油高。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Sorry to interrupt. The note on the bottom seems to say something different.
lines.translation: 抱歉打断一下。瓶底的说明，似乎说的不是这件事。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: Can you read that old writing? They told me it was only decoration.
lines.translation: 你能读懂这行旧文字？店里的人说它只是装饰。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: It says, "For ordinary lighting only. Not for rune lamps." The silver is just decoration.
lines.translation: 它写着“仅供普通照明，不可用于符文灯具”。银线只是包装。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: I nearly bought it. Thank you. The instructions are more useful than the wrapping.
lines.translation: 我差一点就买下了。谢谢你，说明确实比包装有用。

lines.speaker: 摊主
lines.text: Wait... Perhaps the bottles were mixed during delivery. The real rune oil is on the lower shelf.
lines.translation: 等等……可能是搬货时混进来的。真正的符文灯油在下面一层。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Then bring out the instructions too. What it can do should be clear before the sale.
lines.translation: 那就把说明一起拿出来。能做什么，应该先说清楚。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: This one says, "Keeps the wick steady. Keep away from open flames." This time the price is not offered as proof.
lines.translation: 这瓶写着“稳定灯芯，远离明火”。这次没有把价格写成效果。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: The girl checks the seal before paying. A drop of new oil settles the light inside her lantern.
lines.translation: 少女核对封口后才付款。新灯油滴入灯芯，提灯的光安静了下来。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: You are not a regular here, are you? Yet you read the instructions more carefully than the seller.
lines.translation: 你不是这里的常客吧？你看说明时，倒比摊主还熟练。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Lu Chuan. I have just taken over the waystation outside the stone bridge. My shopping experience starts today.
lines.translation: 陆川。刚接手石桥外的驿站，采购经验是今天开始积累的。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: You can call me Lyse. As for the rest... today I am only here to buy lamp oil.
lines.translation: 叫我莉瑟就好。至于其他的……今天我只是来买灯油。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Then today I am simply an innkeeper buying eggs. You need not answer questions beyond the shopping list.
lines.translation: 那我今天也只是买鸡蛋的老板。你不用回答清单之外的问题。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: Salt and vegetables are still on your list. The stall ahead has fresh produce. I can show you.
lines.translation: 你的清单上，还有盐和蔬菜。前面那家比较新鲜，我带你过去。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: They cross to the other side of the market. Flour and eggs will be delivered, leaving Lu Chuan with a basket of vegetables.
lines.translation: 两人走到集市另一侧。面粉和鸡蛋已经约好送货，陆川只需提着蔬菜篮。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Hot soup, bread, and eggs. Just those three things on our first menu.
lines.translation: 热汤、面包、煎蛋。第一天的菜单，暂时就这三样。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: Travelers will appreciate hot soup. More than a long menu, I would like to know if there is a seat.
lines.translation: 赶路的人会喜欢热汤。比起一长串菜名，我更想知道有没有地方坐。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: There is, and the roof no longer leaks. You are welcome to stop by when you pass.
lines.translation: 有，屋顶也不漏了。你路过时，可以来坐一会儿。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: Beyond the stone bridge, beside the main road. I will remember. If I have time this afternoon, I will visit.
lines.translation: 石桥外，大路旁。我记住了。如果下午有空，我去看看。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Wind lifts Lyse's hair near the gate. A pale violet butterfly passes her lantern, and its light bends briefly toward the north.
lines.translation: 镇门的风吹起莉瑟的发梢。一只淡紫蝴蝶掠过提灯，灯芯突然向北侧偏了一下。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: That light just now... That was not the wind, was it?
lines.translation: 刚才那道光……不是被风吹的吧？

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: No. It sometimes reacts to unstable magic. Has anything changed to the north recently?
lines.translation: 不是。它有时会对不稳定的魔力产生反应。北边最近有什么变化吗？

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: I only know there is an old mine road there. Aelia told me not to go that way today.
lines.translation: 我只知道那边有旧矿道。艾莉娅提醒我，今天不要往那里走。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: Then listen to her. Someone buying vegetables need not investigate a mine alone.
lines.translation: 那就听她的。买菜的人，没必要独自去调查矿道。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: I will tell her what happened. First, I will bring the supplies home and open the waystation.
lines.translation: 我会把这件事告诉她。先把食材送回去，让驿站开门。

lines.speaker: 莉瑟
lines.text: Good. Thank you for your help today, Lu Chuan. Keep the direction of that light in mind.
lines.translation: 好。谢谢你今天的帮忙，陆川。也替我留意那盏灯的方向。

lines.speaker: 旁白
lines.text: Lyse disappears into the crowd with her lantern. Lu Chuan heads home with ingredients for the first soup, and one question left unasked.
lines.translation: 莉瑟收起提灯走进人群。陆川踏上回程，篮子里是第一锅热汤的材料，还有一个没问出口的问题。

lines.speaker: 陆川
lines.text: Open the door first, ask questions later. Today's list finally contains more than eggs.
lines.translation: 先开门，再问清楚。今天的清单，终于不只剩鸡蛋了。

ending: 采购完成，陆川认识了化名莉瑟的少女。符文提灯指向北侧旧矿道，他决定先返回驿站，与艾莉娅分享线索。
